name: AutoKeycard for Labs
teaser: Automatically uses the correct keycard when interacting with doors on Labs.
description_html:
AutoKeycard

AutoKeycard is a quality-of-life mod for SPT (Single Player Tarkov) that simplifies keycard door interactions by automatically selecting and using the correct keycard from the player’s inventory.

Instead of manually searching through multiple keycards when interacting with Labs keycard doors, AutoKeycard adds a single interaction option that automatically finds and uses the correct card.

Features

  • Automatically detects locked keycard doors
  • Replaces vanilla keycard interaction options with a single AutoKeycard action
  • Automatically selects the correct keycard from the player’s inventory
  • Prevents incorrect keycard attempts
  • Displays the required keycard name when the player does not have it
  • Optional notification showing which keycard was used
  • Configurable logging and debug options

Compatibility

AutoKeycard releases are tied to specific SPT versions:

  • SPT 4.0.x → Use AutoKeycard v1.0.0

    • Built and tested on SPT 4.0.13
    • Expected to work across the SPT 4.0.x versions

  • SPT 4.1.x → Use AutoKeycard v1.0.1

    • Updated for SPT’s changed interaction system

Compatibility with future SPT versions is not guaranteed until tested.

How It Works

When interacting with a locked keycard door, AutoKeycard:

  1. Detects the available keycard interactions.
  2. Removes the default “Try Keycard” options.
  3. Adds a custom AutoKeycard interaction.
  4. Searches the player’s inventory for a matching keycard.
  5. Validates the keycard’s KeyId against the door’s required KeyId.
  6. Uses EFT’s existing unlock system to complete the interaction.

AutoKeycard does not bypass keycard requirements or unlock doors without the required card. It only automates the normal keycard selection process while preserving EFT’s existing unlock behavior and inventory events.

Requirements

  • SPT
  • BepInEx
